verdictBands.PASS: All criteria PASS; no protocol change indicated
verdictBands.ADVISORY: One criterion WARN; note for sample set, not protocol edit
verdictBands.FAIL: Two or more criteria FAIL, or padding/fabrication — record as recurring weakness if repeated
